Hidden gem Italian restaurant with great food and staff!
Feb 2026 • Couples
We stumbled upon the Pizza House Restaurant while walking in the neighborhood and possibly going to another Italian restaurant. We are so glad we did! It’s a hidden gem!!! While we’d like to keep this gem to ourselves so we can get a table next time, they deserve this 5 star review! 
Look for the white chairs with blue cushions outside. Inside is cozy with brick walls and fun black & white classic movie photos. Cheesy, maybe, but fun! 
Husband had the chicken penne pasta and I had the pasta with clams in a simple white wine, olive sauce, albeit with a kick from a few spicy red peppers. Pasta cooked perfectly. Both were delicious! Reminded us of the similar dishes we had in Italy several years ago. Not over bearing nor over sauced. 
Most importantly, the staff are wonderful!!! Attentive, kind and efficient!! 
We’ll be back if we can get a table next time!!!
